name: Innai Kansen 2
source:
From #1, our doctor has collected a bunch of pets, including the hospital manager's daughter. To gain control of the hospital, he still has to deal with the assistant manager and a rival doctor. To do that, he needs to collect more pets. Strange that some of the girls actually love him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
继前作之后，我们的医生已经收下了一群“宠物”，其中甚至包括医院院长的女儿。为了控制整所医院，他仍需对付副院长和一名竞争对手医生。为此，他必须收下更多“宠物”。奇怪的是，其中有些女孩似乎真的爱上了他。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
